name: Iedema Building Run 2026
description: The Iedema Building Run 2026 in Harderwijk is a sporting event focused on movement, meeting, and entrepreneurship, with a special emphasis on supporting the Princess Beatrix Muscle Fund. Participants can walk, run, and commit to raising money for research into muscle diseases. The event encourages personal and team actions to make a positive impact for people with muscle diseases. It is an accessible and meaningful run for everyone who wants to contribute to a future without muscle diseases.
course_highlights: Support for muscle disease research
Community-oriented charity run
Organized by Sportcentrum Iedema
additional: The event supports the Princess Beatrix Muscle Fund and encourages participants to start personal sponsorship campaigns, contribute as a team, and raise funds for muscle disease research. Participants are encouraged to fundraise and actively participate in an event that promotes movement and community spirit.

name: RUNFORESTRUN Springendal
description: The RUNFORESTRUN Springendal takes place on Saturday, September 23, and runs through the rolling Springendal near Ootmarsum in Twente.

name: Damloop by night 2026
description: The Damloop by night is a unique evening run of 5 miles (8 km) that starts in Amsterdam and finishes in Zaandam. This run is known for its festive atmosphere with great beats and light effects, making it a non-stop party for all participants. The event combines athletic challenge with a lively ambiance, ideal for runners who enjoy a special experience.
course_highlights: Evening run of 5 miles (8 km)
Start in Amsterdam, finish in Zaandam
Festive atmosphere with music and light effects
additional: The Damloop by night is a non-stop party with beats and light acts. There is a special registration procedure for fast runners who finished in the top 3 of the previous edition. Additional products such as the official On Running shirt can also be ordered. The organization pays attention to safety and prevention of overheating among runners. The event includes various race distances, virtual options, and a festive closing. The 8 km race is characterized by a celebratory atmosphere and starts and finishes at the Olympic Stadium.

name: Run & Roast Eindhoven
location: Museumpark VONK, Eindhoven, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Eindhoven takes place on Saturday, September 19, and offers participants a choice of a 5 or 10 kilometer running race, as well as a 1 kilometer kids run for primary school children. The course is flat, fast, and well-paved, with start and finish at Museumpark VONK in the renovated Prehistoric Village in the Genneper Parks. After running, participants can enjoy a delicious plant-based burger from Beyond Meat, music, and a friendly atmosphere with food trucks. There are attractive prizes for the fastest runners and special discount offers for participants.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course of 5 or 10 kilometers through Genneper Parks
Start and finish at Museumpark VONK, in the renovated Prehistoric Village
Well-paved route with one or two laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 15:00 at Brasserie Vonk. A plant-based Beyond Meat burger is included with registration. Discount coupons for All4running and Virtuoos nutritional supplements are available for participants. Prize winners will receive items such as Karhu running shoes, Shokz earphones, and supplement packages. There will be music and a friendly atmosphere with food trucks after the finish. Flat course, start and finish at Museumpark VONK, including burger, music, food trucks, and kids run.

description: The 11th edition of the Kwintelooyen Run takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, in the beautiful nature reserve of the Utrecht Hill Ridge near Rhenen. This running event offers four distances: a kids run of 1 km, and the 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km routes that are entirely on natural terrain. The run supports charities that work for children and young people with disabilities. Participants receive an exclusive Puma running shirt and a medal at the finish, making the event sporty and festive.
course_highlights: Course entirely on natural terrain: forest paths, sandy trails, single trails, and semi-paved sections
Beautiful climbs and panoramic views of the Utrecht Hill Ridge
Quiet and traffic-free routes without asphalt, cobblestones, or traffic lights
additional: The kids run starts at 11:00 AM, the 5 km at 12:00 PM, the 10 km at 1:30 PM, and the 15 km at 2:00 PM. Participants in the 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km receive an exclusive Puma running shirt when picking up their race number. Every runner gets a medal at the finish. Registration with a discounted rate is open until September 13, after which late registration is possible until September 18 as long as start numbers are available. The event supports two charities: Stichting Netwerk voor Jou and Stichting De Wijde Mantel Q-Dreams. Registration until September 13, 2026, with a discount; late registration possible; medals and sports shirts for participants; location in Rhenen on the Utrecht Hill Ridge.

name: Werkhoven Loopt 2026
description: Werkhoven Loopt is a friendly and sporty running event in the Kromme Rijn region, held annually on the third Saturday of September. The 11th edition in 2026 offers running opportunities for young and old, with distances of 1 and 2 km for children and 5 and 10 km for adults. The event is accessible to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its lively and welcoming atmosphere. The organization works with enthusiastic volunteers to make it an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Running through the beautiful Kromme Rijn region
Distances for children (1 and 2 km) and adults (5 and 10 km)
Friendly atmosphere with activities at the Brink
additional: Race numbers can be collected between 15:00 and 17:15. A warm-up is scheduled at 16:25. The event is suitable for all ages and levels, with a festive atmosphere and various activities at the Horecaplein de Brink. Distances: 1 km (kids run), 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; pre-registration recommended; the event takes place at De Brink 5 in Werkhoven.

description: The Woellust Run is a fun and accessible running race in Groningen, with distances for both youth and adults. The 2.5-kilometer course runs zigzag through the neighborhood with no less than 30 turns and many enthusiastic supporters along the route. Youth can participate in the 500 and 1000 meter races, while adults can choose between 5 or 10 kilometers. Attractive prizes are available, including prize money for the top 3 finishers in the 5 and 10 km races and a special prize for setting a new course record.
course_highlights: Course of 2.5 km with 30 turns
Run through the neighborhood with many supporters
Youth races of 500 m and 1000 m, adults 5 and 10 km
additional: Registering on the day of the run incurs an additional fee of € 2.50 per registration. Minimum age for youth 500 m is 4-9 years, for 1000 m 4-11 years, and for 5 and 10 km at least 10 years. The award ceremony for the youth race is at 14:30, and for the 5 and 10 km races at 16:00. There is prize money for the top three finishers in the 5 and 10 km races and a special Primera course record prize for new records on 5 and 10 km. The course starts at the intersection of Duintjerlaan and Sterrenboschlaan. Registration is open. Prizes for the top three and course records.

description: The 4 Miles of Assen is an annual running race held in the Marsdijk neighborhood in Assen, starting and finishing at Anne Frank Square. The ninth edition on September 19, 2026, combines sport with a lively festival, including music, attractions, a fair, and a sports market. The run is suitable for young and old, with various categories such as the main distance of 4 miles, a College Run, and a free Univé Kidsrun for elementary school children. The event also marks the start of the Assen Sports Week and is an important event within the AssenRuns running circuit.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Anne Frank Square in the Marsdijk neighborhood
Course through the northernmost district of Assen
Includes special segments for frame runners (2 miles and 4 miles)
additional: The main distance of 4 Miles has a single start at 14:00, with the front start lane reserved for the fastest runners. The Univé Kidsrun starts at 11:55 with a group warm-up and is free, including a kids' shirt and medal (while supplies last). Clinics are also offered for various groups to prepare for the 4 Miles. On race day, there is a festival with music, attractions, a fair, and a sports market at Anne Frank Park. Registration is currently closed; the event includes running races, a festival, Kids Runs, College Run, clinics, and a sports market.

description: The Mini Marathon Zeewolde is an accessible running event held annually, allowing participants of various ages to compete in distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km, and 4.2 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and supports the Conor Cares foundation, which fights against childhood cancer. The start groups are divided by age, and there is an award ceremony for the fastest runners in each category. Registration is free until September 17, after which the registration fee is 5.50 euros per participant.
course_highlights: Distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km, and 4.2 km
Start groups divided by age
Friendly atmosphere with activities at the Kerkplein
additional: Award ceremony around 14:45 for 1.1 km and at 15:15 for 2.1 km and 4.2 km. There is a relay category with prizes for the fastest team divided into three age categories. After the finish, there is plenty to see and do at the Kerkplein. Distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km, and 4.2 km, including start groups by age, fundraising for childhood cancer, free registration until September 17, then 5.50 euros.

The race offers various distances: 1 km Kidsrun/FrameRunners, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The routes lead towards Camminghaburen and the Groene Ster. After the race, each participant receives a bag with products from Friesland Campina, Dr. Oetker, and Royal Koopmans. The Condensloop is an excellent preparation for the Amsterdam or Eindhoven Marathon, and participation is at your own risk.
course_highlights: Start at the FrieslandCampina Condensfabriek
Routes towards Camminghaburen and the Groene Ster
Various distances from 1 km to half marathon

Routes via afstandmeten.nl, chip timing, refreshment stations, changing facilities, no showers, prizes for records and categories, medals for Kidsrun.

description: The Open Dutch Championship Stair Climbing in Appelscha is an exciting stair climbing race especially for young people aged 10 to 16 years. Participants run as fast as possible up the stairs of the Bosbergtoren, focusing on speed and fitness. The race takes place during the festive Bloom Week and offers a unique opportunity to conquer the Bosberg and test your fitness. In addition to the stair climb, there is a free fitness test on the parking lot of restaurant De Bosberg. Participation is free, but registration is mandatory via Loopsportvereniging Invictus.
course_highlights: Stair climbing of the Bosbergtoren
Start from Boerestreek towards the Bosbergtoren
Viewpoint at the top of the Bosberg
additional: Participants gather between 11:15 and 11:30 AM on Boerestreek. A free fitness test is available on the parking lot of restaurant De Bosberg. Participation is at your own risk. Start time at 12:00 PM, participation for young people mandatory via registration, event location: Bosbergtoren in Appelscha

name: Run2day Bosloop Veenhuizen
description: The Run2day Bosloop in Veenhuizen is a friendly and small-scale running race that takes place four times a year. The routes run through the forests and heathlands of Veenhuizen, with distances of 3, 5, and 10 kilometers, each with its own course. The start is at the sports hall on Kerklaan, which also offers changing and shower facilities. The race is suitable for young and old and attracts an average of 40 to 100 participants per edition.
course_highlights: Routes through forests and heathlands of Veenhuizen
Distances of 3, 5, and 10 kilometers with their own courses
Start and facilities at sports hall Kerklaan Veenhuizen
additional: Registration can be done on-site from 9:00 to 10:15 AM or in advance via a registration form on the website until Thursday before the event. Timing is recorded and results are available online within 2 days. A laptop with registered times is available in the canteen of the sports hall. The race takes place four times a year, with pre-registration via the website or on the day itself. The event is small-scale and suitable for all ages.

price_tiers.distance: The Virtual 40th NN Dam tot Damloop

description: The NN Dam tot Damloop is the biggest running event in the Netherlands, starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The 10-mile race takes you through the unique IJ Tunnel and past lively music and cheers in Amsterdam-Noord. In 2026, this event celebrates its 40th edition with a festive program and an unforgettable finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam. After crossing the finish line, you can relax in Dam tot Dam Park during the Finish Festival.
course_highlights: Start on Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam
Run through the IJ Tunnel between the city center and Amsterdam-Noord
Finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam with a community festival on Zuiddijk
additional: Registration starts in phases: members of Le Champion can register from April 6 to April 17, after which regular registration opens on April 18. A Premium Business Package is available for teams. The Business Run is popular among companies with more than 25,000 participants. A free BackStory starting number is available. After the finish, there is a Finish Festival in Dam tot Dam Park. Participants can choose from multiple distances, virtual options, and special anniversary activities. The event has a festive and supportive atmosphere with music and merchandise available.

name: Misty Lakes Trail
description: The Misty Lakes Trail is a challenging trail run taking place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in the beautiful forests around Lieshout, Gerwen, Nuenen, Geldrop, Mierlo, and Stiphout. The routes start and finish in Gerwen (Nuenen) and consist of more than 90% unpaved paths with short climbs and winding single tracks. The trail passes by many beautiful ponds and heath areas, known for their natural beauty and the mysterious morning mist. The different distances offer a nice challenge for every level, with a renewed 36 km route and a 55 km route that climbs the 'Roof of Brabant', the Gulbergen.
course_highlights: More than 90% unpaved paths
Winding single tracks and short climbs
Visit to the 'Roof of Brabant', the over 60-meter-high Gulbergen
additional: The start and finish location is ’t Huysven De Huikert 35, 5674 RG Nuenen. There is a stand from partner NNormal where trail runners can test trail shoes. On site, there is also a pop-up store with trail gear. The event is organized by Runnersclub Lieshout. There is an option to transfer start numbers via Inschrijven.nl and a resale platform. A friendly atmosphere with a terrace, BBQ, and activities for children at the finish between 11:30 and 15:30. Trail run on unpaved paths with marking and GPX files, start and finish in Gerwen (Nuenen), facilities such as changing rooms, showers, and first aid, and a free start for participants.

name: LOS Dokkum
distance_verbose: 50 km, Marathon, Halve marathon, 13.4 km, 6.7 km

description: LOS Dokkum is a unique 12-hour running and walking event in Tolhuispark in Dokkum. Every hour, the start signal sounds for a round of 6.7 kilometers of running or 3.9 kilometers of walking. The challenge is to determine how long you can keep going and to answer the question again and again: shall I do another lap? The event combines sportiness with a friendly atmosphere in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Round of 6.7 kilometers of running per hour
Walking route of 3.9 kilometers through Tolhuispark
Start signal every hour for 12 hours
additional: The event takes place in Tolhuispark. Participants can choose between running and walking. The start signal sounds again every hour, giving a unique dynamic to the event. The event supports good causes and is organized by volunteers and local entrepreneurs. It is accessible for teams and children, and is part of an annual recurring initiative.

name: Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run
description: The Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run is a charming running event in the green surroundings of the Gravenallee in Almelo. The event offers distances for both beginner and experienced runners, including a new 2-kilometer youth and beginner run. The start and finish are at the ice rink opposite the sports park, with a course along wide avenues and a popular, atmospheric environment. It promises a sporty and convivial day for athletes, supporters, and visitors of all ages.
course_highlights: Course along wide avenues in the green Gravenallee
Start and finish at the ice rink opposite the sports park
Atmospheric environment with participation of Huize Almelo
additional: Distances for all ages and levels, including a new 2-kilometer youth and beginner run. Start and finish at Ice Rink Almelo, Sluiskade Zuidzijde 195, 7607XT Almelo. Event runs from 10:30 to 13:00. Routes through rural areas, possibility for training at athletics club SISU, participation for all ages, focus on health and community.

name: Freedom Run - Libertyloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16.09 km, 8 km, 3000 meter, 1.6 km
description: Freedom Run - Liberty Loop is a recreational run taking place in Geldrop to celebrate 80 years of liberation. The race offers four running distances named after well-known veterans, and a half marathon. Additionally, there is a free Kidsrun for primary school children and various walking routes along war monuments and streets named after resistance fighters. The event emphasizes celebrating freedom together and offers a unique combination of sport and history.
course_highlights: Four running distances named after veterans: 4, 8, 10 miles and half marathon
Walking routes along war monuments and streets of resistance fighters in Geldrop
Free Kidsrun for primary school children with 1/2 and 1 mile distances
additional: Start times vary per distance: walking starts between 9:00 and 10:00 AM, Kidsrun at 10:15 AM, running between 10:45 and 11:15 AM. Walking and running routes are available as GPX files. Participation is at own risk and free for children up to and including 15 years old when walking. Registration opens from May 5 via the website. Participants can choose from various distances, including 3 km, 1.6 km, 8 km, 10 miles, and a half marathon. The event takes place at the Weeffabriek in Geldrop and starts on September 20, 2026. Registration opens on May 5, 2026.

name: Rondjes van Pijn
description: Round of Pijn is an endurance race organized by the Pijnacker Ice Association, held on Sunday, September 20, 2026, at the Tinteltent in Pijnacker. The race consists of repeating laps of 4.2 kilometers, starting every half hour, with a maximum of ten laps. Participants can set their own pace, with a faster lap providing more rest time before the next start. The event targets both youth and adults and emphasizes endurance over speed.
course_highlights: Repeating laps of 4.2 km every half hour
Maximum of ten laps possible
Course in and around the Tinteltent, Pijnacker
additional: Participation is at your own risk; participants are responsible for training and insurance. The course is shared with recreational runners, and traffic controllers are present at some challenging spots. Dogs are welcome on parts of the course. Repeating laps of 4.2 km, maximum distance of approximately 42 km, registration via website, dogs welcome on parts of the course, safety and responsibility are emphasized.

name: Halve en Kwart Marathon van Cranendonck
Zombies are Coming 180km
description: Zombies are Coming is a unique 180-kilometer ultramarathon from Amsterdam to Groningen, where participants must maintain a constant speed of 7.5 km/h to finish within 24 hours. Participants carry everything themselves and run without a crew, while being chased by a 'zombie horde' that eliminates them if they fall behind the pace. It is not a race against other runners, but a personal challenge to reach the finish and stay ahead of the zombies.
course_highlights: 180 kilometers from Amsterdam to Groningen
Constant speed of 7.5 km/h required
Rolling cutoff: those overtaken by the zombie horde must stop
additional: Participants must carry everything themselves; no crew is allowed. The race has a rolling cutoff where anyone overtaken by the zombie horde (moving at 7.5 km/h) must stop. Return travel is arranged by the participants themselves, but there is a zombie vehicle that can assist in reaching a public transport point. Route in the Netherlands, in darkness and light, with public water points, no aid stations or volunteers on site.

name: Martini Marathon
price_range: 4,22 euro voor sololopers, 21,10 euro voor estafetteteams
description: The Martini Marathon in Groningen is a unique marathon on the athletics track, organized by Groningen Atletiek. The race takes place on Friday evening, September 25, 2026, and offers both a solo marathon of 42.195 meters and a relay for teams of 3 to 5 runners. The relay consists of distances of 2,195 meters and four times 10,000 meters, ensuring a challenging and fast running experience. The atmosphere is friendly with catering along the way and after the event, and all participants receive a medal. The winners receive the prestigious Martini Bokaal.
course_highlights: Marathon on the athletics track Stadspark Groningen
Relay with distances of 2,195 m and 4×10,000 m
Maximum of 60 participants on the track at the same time
additional: Maximum of 60 runners on the track at the same time, with a reserve list for additional registrations. The maximum time to complete the marathon is 5 hours and 15 minutes. Catering is available during and after the event. Start and finish are at the athletics track Stadspark Groningen, which also offers changing and baggage storage. The organization is handled by Alex Jager on behalf of Groningen Atletiek. Track race with solo and relay variants, registration opens on 01-01-2026, maximum participant numbers and time limits apply.

description: The 5 of Bavel is an annual running event in ’t Klooster, Bavel, celebrating its 10th anniversary in 2026. The event offers a fun and sporty day for young and old with various distances, including a 5 km race, a 10 km trim run, and a kids run. The start and finish are centrally located on Kloosterstraat at Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel. The 5 of Bavel also supports a good cause, namely research into neuroendocrine tumors (NET).
course_highlights: 5 km race and 10 km trim run with multiple laps through the village
Kids run of about 500 meters with start and finish in Kloosterstraat
Start and finish at Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel in Kloosterstraat
additional: Registration and pick-up of start numbers from 13:00 on race day at ’t Klooster. The Berenboot kids run starts at 16:00, followed by the 5 km race at 16:15 and the 10 km trim run at 17:00. Prizes for the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers in each run are awarded immediately afterward. The running event includes various components, volunteers, and traffic controllers; part of the Bavelse fair; registration via website and on-site.

name: Run for Hope
location: Dordrecht Biesbosch, Dordrecht, South Holland, Netherlands
description: Run for Hope is an inspiring running race taking place on September 26, 2026, in the Dordtse Biesbosch. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 21.1 kilometers and run to raise money for clients of De Hoop, who receive support in rebuilding their lives. The run is centered around hope and solidarity, with runners encouraged by supporters and collectively contributing to a social cause. The event combines athleticism with meaningful support for others.
course_highlights: Running through the scenic environment of Dordtse Biesbosch
Choice of three distances: 5, 10, and 21.1 kilometers
A run with a social purpose and lots of support along the course
additional: The proceeds from the run are used to support clients of De Hoop in reintegrating into society. The goal is to raise a total of 75,000 euros. The organization emphasizes the importance of solidarity and experiencing fulfillment during the run. Distances of 5, 10, and 21.1 km; charity fundraising; scenic run through Dordrecht Biesbosch.

name: Spanderswoud Trailrun
location: s-Graveland, Gooise Meren, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Spanderswoud Trailrun is a relaxed trail run through the beautiful Spanderswoud and surrounding natural areas in the Gooi. The routes of 10, 20, and 30 km take you over winding forest paths, singletracks, and open heathlands, without a competitive element or time pressure. The start and finish are at the visitor center of Natuurmonumenten on Landgoed Boekesteyn in ’s-Graveland. There are refreshment stations along the way, and after the race, you can enjoy a snack and drink at Café-Restaurant Brambergen.
course_highlights: Fully marked routes of 10 and 20 km, 30 km partly via GPX
Varied terrain with singletracks, forest paths, and heathlands
Start and finish at the visitor center of Natuurmonumenten on Landgoed Boekesteyn
additional: Start times for 10 and 20 km are between 09:00 and 11:30 in five time blocks; participants choose their own start time. There are two refreshment stations (approximately at 5 km and at the finish; longer distances have an extra station). First aid is available at start/finish. The 30 km route requires experience with GPX navigation. There is no timing or cups at refreshment stations; participants are advised to bring their own cup or order an EpicTrails softcup. Parking is available; carpooling is recommended. Part of the registration fee goes to nature organizations. Trail routes follow forest paths, sandy stretches, and narrow trails; no competitive element; start times during registration; GPX data for long distances; finisher medal; no cups, own cup or softcup recommended.

name: Crob Run
description: The Crob Run is a running event in Haaften taking place on September 26, 2026. It offers a beautiful run over the dikes around Haaften and through nature along the Waal River, suitable for young and old. There are various distances, including kids runs for children aged 5 to 12, and 5 km and 10 km for adults. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere with music, food stalls, and a bar, and part of the proceeds go to a good cause.
course_highlights: Run over the dikes around Haaften
Beautiful nature along the Waal River
Friendly atmosphere with DJ, food stalls, and terrace
additional: Kids runs start between 14:00 and 14:30, and the 5 km and 10 km races start together at 15:30. There is a refreshment station with water on the 5 km and 10 km routes, and fruit and extra water are available at the finish. Changing rooms are available for men and women. The event area is open until 18:00 with a DJ, food stalls, bar, and terrace. First aid is available in the building of the Burcht van Haeften. There is no registration deadline, but the event is full once capacity is reached. There is a time limit of 1 hour and 30 minutes for the 5 km and 10 km races. Parking is free around the Burcht van Haeften; cycling and carpooling are recommended. Participants can enjoy a festive atmosphere with music, food trucks, and a medal referencing the mill and the blue heron in Haaften. The event supports charities such as ROPA run and is wheelchair accessible with adapted sanitary facilities.

name: Hill Repeat Madness: 4-uurs trailrunchallenge
location: Landgoed Gulbergen, Nuenen, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Hill Repeat Madness is a challenging 4-hour trail running challenge taking place at Landgoed Gulbergen in Nuenen. This trail run challenges runners to test their endurance and speed on a varied course in a natural environment. The event is organized by Trailrunners Brabant, known for their passion for trail running and creating a sporty and friendly atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail runners who enjoy an intensive and dynamic running experience.
course_highlights: Trail run at Landgoed Gulbergen with natural surroundings
4-hour challenge focusing on endurance and speed
Varied course suitable for trail running
additional: Participants can register via WeTicket. The event takes place at 't Dak van Brabant in Nuenen, with a route of approximately 2.5 km per lap, including elevation changes. There are no facilities for showering or changing, and volunteers can sign up for support.

name: BEAT Running Festival

The route passes along rivers, canals, drawbridges, and moats, and goes through the most beautiful spots of the historic city center, including the oldest university in the Netherlands, Hortus Botanicus, and various monuments. The walk takes place on Saturday, September 26, 2026, and the running race on Sunday, September 27, 2026. There are different distances available, so both recreational walkers and runners can participate.

The track is illuminated with candles, LED lights, and atmospheric lighting, while a DJ provides music and energy. Each participant has one hour to run as many laps as possible, with options to be sponsored per lap or with a fixed amount. The Nightrun is suitable for young and old, with special start groups and a unique experience of sport, camaraderie, and club spirit.

Music and energy provided by a DJ throughout the evening

name: Pieken+Dalen Festival
location: RCN het Grote Bos, Doorn, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: On Saturday, October 3, 2026, the very first Pieken+Dalen Festival will take place at RCN Het Grote Bos in Doorn, organized by Stichting DiabetesPlus. This unique event combines walking and running over various distances, from a 5-kilometer loop to a marathon, on the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. After the effort, a warm reception awaits at the festival grounds with meet-and-greets, music, a Buddy Tent, Q&A sessions with diabetes researchers, a TechTent, and various food trucks. The festival offers a special opportunity to face the peaks and valleys of blood sugar levels together with friends, family, and sports enthusiasts in a lively and connecting environment.
course_highlights: Diverse wandel- en hardloopafstanden van 5 km tot marathon
Prachtige heuvelachtige natuur van de Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Festivalterrein met muziek, speeltuin, en diabetestechnologie
additional: Na de sportieve activiteiten is er een festivalterrein met een Buddy Tent, Q&A met diabetesonderzoekers, TechTent met nieuwste diabetestechnologie, muziekoptredens door type 1-ers, een speeltuin voor kinderen, een loterij met prijzen en diverse foodtrucks met eten en drinken. Wandel- en hardloopactiviteiten, technologische en sociale activiteiten, foodtrucks, familie- en kindvriendelijk

name: 11e Molenloop (Molensmooiste) Alblasserdam-Kinderdijk
description: Molensmooiste is a unique running race taking place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in the UNESCO World Heritage site Kinderdijk. Participants run past all the iconic windmills of the area, with the 10 English Miles consisting of two laps and the 5 English Miles of one lap. The start and finish are located in the middle of the windmill area, providing a special and atmospheric experience. With a limit of 1,500 participants and organized under the auspices of AAA Atletiekvereniging Alblasserdam, it is an event for both recreational and passionate runners.
course_highlights: Route goes truly along all the windmills of Kinderdijk
10 EM consists of two laps of 8 km along the windmill area
Start and finish in the middle of the UNESCO World Heritage site
additional: Start and finish are in the middle of the windmill area with waves based on pace due to narrow start path. Bib number and shoetag can be picked up from 07:00 in the runners' village, no later than 09:00. There is one water station per lap. Kidsrun takes place on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at the AAA Atletiekbaan Alblasserdam and is free; registration on site. The race includes wave starts for different distances, is part of the Grote Rivieren Loopcircuit, and registration is open until maximum capacity is reached. Late registration is not possible.

Start groups based on expected finish time for comparable competition

description: The Half Marathon Oldenzaal is a popular running event held in the rolling Twente landscape. The half marathon route passes several highlights such as Tankenberg, Wilmersberg, Hakenberg, and Paasberg, and is mostly paved with refreshment stations every 5 kilometers. The race is suitable for both individual runners and corporate teams and has a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. In addition to the half marathon, there are also distances of 10 kilometers, 5 kilometers, a corporate run, and school runs, making the event accessible to a wide audience.

Mostly paved course with refreshment stations every 5 kilometers

Youth participants have separate start times for 1 km and 2 km school runs. Information about course changes, start times, registration tips, and safety measures. The event is popular among local and recreational runners.

The run takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, and is organized by AV Dem. The atmosphere is sporty and challenging, with a playful theme where participants can compete to become the 'ruler of Heemskerk'.

Distances ranging from 3.3 km to a half marathon (21.1 km)

description: The Prevox Startbaan Run is a monthly running race held on the athletics track of AV Startbaan in Amstelveen. The race offers distances of 1, 3, and 5 kilometers, with the 1-kilometer race also accessible to young runners. Electronic timing is used to accurately record lap times and finish times. On Sunday, October 4, 2026, the 55th edition of this popular race will take place, with pre-registration available via Inschrijven.nl.
course_highlights: Race on the athletics track of AV Startbaan
Distances of 1, 3, and 5 kilometers
Electronic timing with lap times

Results with intermediate and lap times are published, among others, on uitslagen.nl. Pre-registration via Inschrijven.nl ensures that the start number is ready upon arrival. Run on athletics track, electronic timing, monthly event, including youth race

name: 8 van Drachten
description: The 8 of Drachten is an annual running event in the heart of Friesland, suitable for young and old. With various distances, including an 8 km race, a KidsRun, and a Business Run, the event offers a suitable challenge for every runner. The atmospheric course and the sporty community make this event a festive and professional running experience in Drachten. The 22nd edition will take place on Sunday, October 4, 2026.
course_highlights: Atmospheric course in the heart of Drachten
Distances for young and old, including KidsRun and Business Run
Sporty community and professional organization
additional: Registration closes on September 12, 2026 at 12:00 PM and is only possible online. Late registration is not possible. Start numbers can be transferred via a resale platform. There is an award ceremony immediately after the race segments. The KidsRun starts at 2:00 PM, and the 8 km and Business Run start at 3:00 PM. Registration is possible via the website, and the event is supported by an active online community on Instagram.

The race offers various distances, including a youth run of 1 km, and races of 5 km, 10 km, and 10 miles. The event is known for its enthusiastic atmosphere and is fully organized by volunteers. Participants are rewarded with a commemorative medal and there are prizes for the best runners in various categories.

Start in age categories for the youth run with 1-minute intervals
Prize ceremony shortly after the completion of each distance next to the finish line

name: 57e Langs de Gouweloop
description: The 57th Langs de Gouweloop takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, in Waddinxveen, with start and finish at the Gouweplein near the shopping center. This annual family running event, organized by Sportclub Antilope, offers something for everyone: a Kidsrun of 1.3 km for children up to 12 years old and competitive runs of 5 and 10 km for runners aged 12 and above. The route is a 5-kilometer loop that is run twice for the 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting achievements, welcoming both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Loop of 5 kilometers, run twice for the 10 km
Start and finish at the Gouweplein of the Waddinxveen Shopping Center
Suitable for all ages with Kidsrun and competitive runs
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sporthal De Dreef opposite the shopping center. Late registration is possible until half an hour before the start. There is no electronic timing; times can be read on a clock at the start and finish. Parking is available at Sporthal De Dreef and in the parking garage under the shopping center, with the first two hours free. Route along Gouweplein, discounted registration, family-friendly event.

description: The Kanonsloop Groenlo is a atmospheric running event that will be held for the 38th time on Sunday, October 4, 2026. The race features a renewed 10 km course along well-known spots in and around Groenlo, such as Bommelwereld, Camping Marveld, the Groenlo canal, and De Grolse Weiden city park. In addition to the 10 km, there is also the familiar 5 km distance, and a special corporate run with a friendly conclusion at Brouwernös Proeflokaal. The start and finish are at the Music Dome on Maliebaan / Wheme in Groenlo. The organization ensures a safe and sportive atmosphere with traffic controllers and timing registration via Race Result.
course_highlights: Renewed 10 km course along Bommelwereld, Camping Marveld, Groenlo canal, and De Grolse Weiden city park
Familiar 5 km Kaakronde
Start and finish at the Music Dome in Groenlo
additional: Timing registration with reusable chips on the back of the start number. Start numbers are collected after finishing. Parking available at Wheme, Boompjeswal, and Kerkwal, not at Maliebaan. Corporate run with teams of 3-5 participants, concluding with snacks and drinks at Brouwernös Proeflokaal. Late registration possible until 10:45 AM on race day at primary school ’t Carillon, Wheme 30, payment in cash or card. Renewed course, course through Groenlo, online and on-site registration, start and finish location at Maliebaan/Wheme, various parking options, refreshments at the finish, award ceremony afterwards.

name: TREK Singelloop Utrecht

description: The TREK Singelloop Utrecht is the oldest street race in the Netherlands and an annual running event in the beautiful city of Utrecht. The race offers a fast, fully traffic-free route along the Utrecht canals and Wilhelminapark, where thousands of runners enjoy from start to finish. In addition to the 10 km and 5 km distances, there are also Kids Runs, Business Runs, and a half marathon. The organization supports KWF Kankerbestrijding (Dutch Cancer Society) and encourages participants to raise funds for this good cause.
course_highlights: Flat, paved, and completely traffic-free roads
Route along the Utrecht canals and Wilhelminapark
Officially measured courses for 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
additional: Start waves are used to ensure a smooth and safe start, with waves of approximately 15 minutes for the 5 km and 20 minutes for the 10 km. Race bibs can be sent home for €4.50 when registering before August 31, otherwise they can be picked up at the event site. A unique limited edition running shirt is available for €27. Participation includes on-course and post-finish refreshments. The organization encourages participants to raise funds for KWF Kankerbestrijding via a personal fundraising page. Participants can register through the official website, with options for fundraising for KWF Kankerbestrijding and participation in various distances.

Runners of all ages and levels run together along a beautiful route by the water and through the green landscape of the IJzeren Man. The Volksloop focuses on movement and enjoyment, allowing everyone to participate at their own pace. There are various distances available, including special youth distances and a time limit for seniors. The start is at the beach area in front of the Hertenkamp on Geurtsvenweg.

Start at the beach area in front of the Hertenkamp on Geurtsvenweg in Weert

Participants can register until 9:45 AM on the day of the race. Participation is free for youths under 16 with pre-registration. The event includes various race categories, including youth and senior races, and offers prizes for winners and jubilaries.

name: Trailrun Den Bosch
description: Trailrun Den Bosch is a running event in 's-Hertogenbosch with two distances: 8 km and 16 km. The race offers an accessible trail running experience for runners who want to enjoy a challenging course in a beautiful environment. The organization invites runners to share their experiences and to prepare well with training schedules from partners. The event is part of the WeTri platform, which supports triathletes and runners with comprehensive race information and training options.
course_highlights: Two distances: 8 km and 16 km
Trail run course in the surroundings of 's-Hertogenbosch
Accessible for different levels
additional: Participants can prepare with training schedules from partner Optrimize. There is a community (TRTHLN Club) for sharing plans and race reports. The platform also offers tools for creating packing lists and nutrition plans. The race takes place in a natural environment with trail paths, suitable for both beginner and experienced trail runners. Registration costs €10 and the race offers a nice challenge for trail enthusiasts.

name: Janlouterloop
description: The Janlouterloop is an annual running event in the Vlaardingse Broekpolder, organized in memory of Jan Louter, a passionate runner and coach who passed away in 2024 from pancreatic cancer. The run offers participants a choice of three running distances (5, 10, and 15 kilometers) and a 10-kilometer walk. The event is organized by AV Fortuna and supports the charity 'Support Casper', part of the Foundation Surviving with Pancreatic Cancer. The Janlouterloop combines sportiness with camaraderie and nature experience in a unique polder environment.
course_highlights: Course through the Vlaardingse Broekpolder with the 'Janlouterlaan', a favorite natural spot of Jan Louter
Choice of 5, 10, and 15 kilometers running and a 10-kilometer walk
Refreshments along the route, changing and shower facilities, and a beautiful medal
additional: The proceeds of the event go to the charity 'Support Casper', part of the Foundation Surviving with Pancreatic Cancer. There are changing and shower facilities and refreshments along the route. The run takes place in the Broekpolder, a unique nature reserve in Vlaardingen. Terrain in Vlaardingse Broekpolder, registration via contact form, proceeds go to cancer support.

name: ASML Marathon Eindhoven
description: The ASML Marathon Eindhoven is the largest two-day sporting event in North Brabant, taking place annually in the second weekend of October. The event offers a wide range of running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon, and various other runs for young and old. The course is flat, wide, and atmospheric with a finish in the center of Eindhoven, ensuring fast times and a unique experience. The city is fully dedicated to sports, innovation, and connection, with enthusiastic supporters along the route. This makes the ASML Marathon Eindhoven a festive and internationally recognized running event.
course_highlights: Flat and wide course with finish in the center of Eindhoven
Atmospheric and enthusiastic cheering along the route
Route passing iconic locations in the city
additional: Participants receive a unique medal. A limited edition running shirt is available. There are special actions for 'Run against cancer' where participants can raise funds and receive a unique shirt. Registration numbers for Dutch participants are available until September 1. The finish is at the lively Vestdijk in the center of Eindhoven. Two-day event with registrations for various distances, start and finish in the center of Eindhoven, including urban walk and children's activities.

name: 1 MIJL IN LINE

It is a unique race over 1,609 meters in a straight line on the Lange Biesakkersweg, halfway between Klaaswaal and Numansdorp. Participants can enjoy a fast and straight route with a nice trophy for each participant and prizes for the winners. Registration is open until October 9 via inschrijven.nl, with the possibility of late registration on the day itself from 4:00 PM.

Start halfway between Klaaswaal and Numansdorp
Fast and clear route

The race takes place on flat terrain along the Lange Biesakkersweg, with registration possible via inschrijven.nl. The event starts at 4:00 PM and is part of regional festivities, with facilities for participants and spectators.

name: 10e Oosterhoutse Trail
description: The Oosterhoutse Trail celebrates its 10th anniversary edition on Saturday, October 10, 2026. This unique trail running event has been offering beautiful routes and challenging unpaved paths in a friendly atmosphere for ten years. Participants can choose from three different distances, suitable for various levels. Especially for this anniversary edition, the first 100 registrants will receive an exclusive anniversary shirt. After the race, the celebration will be jointly commemorated with a festive closing event.

Challenging and diverse course
Stunning trail routes in the vicinity of Oosterhout

description: The Veluwepoort Run is a road running event in Nijkerk that takes place annually, with a fall edition on October 10, 2026. Participants can choose from distances of 5 km and 10 km. The event is organized by AV Nijkerk and combines athletic challenge with a playful element, allowing participants to compete to become the 'ruler of Nijkerk'. The race takes place on a Saturday and offers a great opportunity to meet running friends and achieve personal goals.
course_highlights: Road race in Nijkerk
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Organized by AV Nijkerk

name: DECAloop Utrecht
description: The DECAloop Utrecht is a challenging running race taking place in Utrecht on October 10, 2026. The race covers a distance of 67 kilometers and starts at 08:00 AM. The event offers a unique opportunity for long-distance runners to test their endurance in a scenic environment. Registration is simple via an online form, and the price is very attractive for this distance.
course_highlights: Long distance of 67 kilometers
Starts at 08:00 AM
Organized in the city of Utrecht
additional: Registration is via a Google Docs form. The price is €20.00 for the entire 67 km distance. The price per kilometer is approximately €0.30. The race may be combined with other trail events in the region, such as the DECAloop Backyard Ultra and Utrechtse Heuvelrug Ultra Trail.

name: Mijn City Run Ede
description: My City Run Ede is a unique running event taking place in the center of Ede on October 10, 2026. The race consists of a fast and spectacular 1-kilometer course through the city center, with an accessible program for young and old, including kids runs, a family run, and a business run. The day concludes with a final where the fastest recreational runners compete against (inter)national top athletes. The event combines sportiness with a festive atmosphere and is accessible to everyone, including athletes with disabilities.
course_highlights: 1 kilometer course through the center of Ede
Start at the Town Hall Square, finish at the Old Church
Route passes Achterdoelen, Maanderplein, and Museumplein
additional: The event features a movement square with information and testing stations. There are various qualification rounds for fast runners and youth, followed by a final with elite athletes. There is a corporate ranking where the four fastest times per company are summed. The course is accessible for athletes with disabilities, including participants with a running frame. Toilets are available at the start/finish. There is no cloakroom; participants are advised to leave valuables at home or hand them over to spectators. Late registration is limited. The event is open to all ages with registration via the website, including a movement square and prizes.

name: LoveLife Run Amsterdam
description: LoveLife Run Amsterdam is a special running event taking place on October 10th at the Olympic Stadium. Tough (former) cancer patients run together with their loved ones and caregivers 5 or 10 kilometers to raise funds for groundbreaking cancer research. Everyone is welcome to participate or support participants, even if you have not had cancer yourself. The event combines a sporting challenge with a powerful message of hope and involvement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the iconic Olympic Stadium Amsterdam
Distances of 5 km and 10 km for participants and loved ones
Group warm-up and finish with a cheer moment
additional: Participants receive a LoveLife Run sports shirt and a medal. There is a 12-week training program guided by specialized trainers. After the run, there is a joint cheer moment. The event recommends using public transport or cycling due to crowds and parking costs around the Olympic Stadium. The event is open to everyone, including (former) cancer patients, their families, friends, and caregivers. It focuses on recovery, self-confidence, and community spirit, with a special emphasis on support and fundraising for cancer research.

name: Hernense Stratenloop
description: The Hernense Street Run is a small-scale, recreational running race held in the picturesque village of Hernen. On Saturday, October 10, 2026, the 17th edition will take place with four distances: 600 meters, 1200 meters, 5 kilometers, and 10 kilometers. The routes pass through the village and the beautiful countryside, along the medieval castle, the grain mill, the Hernense forest, and the rural Leur. The event is suitable for young and old and offers a sporty and friendly afternoon with a warm atmosphere and many spectators along the route.
course_highlights: Running past the medieval castle of Hernen
Route through the rural Leur and the Hernense forest
Renewed 10 km route with beautiful views and a refreshment station halfway
